video.title: Hot Since 82 | Mixmag Lab London
video.description:
Hot Since 82 takes control of the Mixmag Lab London at Wagtail Rooftop, celebrating the release of his brand new album ‘Obsessions’ with a incredible two hour DJ set of quality house, new tracks and his own remixes.‘Obsessions’ marks a new chapter for Hot Since 82, bringing together nine new tracks shaped by a period of touring, movement and introspection. Hear the album here: https://www.hotsince82.com

One of the leading names in contemporary house and tech-house, Hot Since 82 steps into the Mixmag Lab London once again for a special set on the Wagtail Rooftop.   Hot Since 82 has become a fixture across the global club and festival circuit, with appearances at events including Ibiza residencies, Tomorrowland, Creamfields, Sonus and major clubs around the world. His sound sits alongside artists such as Jamie Jones, Marco Carola, Nic Fanciulli, Solomun, CamelPhat, Kölsch, blending deep house, tech-house and melodic electronic music with the signature sound of his Knee Deep In Sound label. This Mixmag Lab set captures that sound  on the Wagtail Rooftop, with panoramic views of London, featuring music from ‘Obsessions’ alongside club-focused selections built for the dancefloor.
